text: Expedia's Liverpool sleeve deal is with Expedia Group, Inc., a Delaware-incorporated company listed on Nasdaq (EXPE) and the parent of the Expedia, Hotels.com and Vrbo brands. It has a dispersed public float with index managers (BlackRock, Vanguard, State Street) as the largest holders and no controlling shareholder or state stake. Human-rights relevance: none material beyond big-tech/consumer-Internet norms.
